technology.summary: Today's technology news includes a new California law that will fine robotaxi operators for blocking first responders. Elon Musk's Grokipedia has received a design refresh, and the new Kindle has been released without a raised bezel. Audible has introduced new features that allow users to explore book worlds and interact with characters, while hearing tech startup Legato has launched AI hearing glasses. Samsung has raised prices on the Galaxy S26 by $100, and TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is focusing on building enduring companies in the AI era.

finance.summary: Today's most important finance news includes a decline in Indian equity benchmarks due to profit booking and rising oil prices, with the Nifty 50 index closing down by 95.75 points. The Securities and Exchange Board of India and the Reserve Bank of India have teamed up to make it easier for foreign portfolio investors to enter the market. A resurgent El Niño pattern could deepen a selloff in Southeast Asian bonds, pushing yields higher as rising US Treasury rates and oil prices squeeze regional debt. Market experts have shared their top stock picks for 1 October, while the Supreme Court of India has urged a probe into reports of patients being directed to specific pharmacies for their medications, leading to a steep drop in the BSE Hospitals Index.

politics.summary:
The Parliamentary panel has postponed its visit to the Supreme Court over concerns about the separation of powers. The Assam government has ordered that ambulances should not be stopped for VIP convoys, following a backlash after police stopped an ambulance in Silchar. The Election Commission has been accused of making a mockery of the Constitution by Dipankar during a Jan Sunwai in Patna.

In other news, Andhra Pradesh HRD Minister Lokesh has asked officials to set skill training targets, and a retired official has been arrested under the POCSO Act in Ongole after a girl's friend called 112. Nitin Gadkari has called ethanol blending a step towards diversification of the agricultural sector, and three officials have been killed in a Mizoram accident.
